title: Saver Reduction of the Pocketwire Personal Account Instant Transfer Fee
content:
Customers who save in a Pocketwire Savings Vault pay a reduced instant transfer fee on cash-outs from their Pocketwire Personal Account.

**Rule.** The saver fee reduction of the instant transfer fee reads the balance of the customer's active Pocketwire Savings Vault (a vault that is time-locked, frozen or closed does not count): at USD 5000.00 or more it is 20 percent, at USD 1000.00 or more but below 5000.00 it is 10 percent, and below 1000.00 or with no active vault it is 0 percent.

| Balance of the active Pocketwire Savings Vault | Saver fee reduction |
|---|---|
| 5000.00 or more | 20 percent |
| 1000.00 up to 4999.99 | 10 percent |
| Below 1000.00 | 0 percent |
| No active vault (none held, or time-locked, frozen or closed) | 0 percent |

**Cases (hypothetical fee of 12.00 and vault balances)**

| Vault | Reduction | Fee after the reduction |
|---|---|---|
| Active, 5000.00 | 20 percent | 9.60 |
| Active, 999.99 | 0 percent | 12.00 |
| Active, 1000.00 | 10 percent | 10.80 |
| Frozen, 8000.00 | 0 percent | 12.00 |
